verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many Items is a fair question for an API platform like Plaid, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no batch or bulk endpoint. The cited material covers only per-Item calls (e.g., transactionsSync), the ability to create unlimited Sandbox test Items, webhooks, and a diagnostics MCP server, none of which is a capability to act on many Items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
